DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 94 s. 2021 JUL 19 2021 HON. NOEL G. PINEDA Vice-Mayor Sangguniang Panlungsod Malolos, Bulacan Dear Vice-Mayor Pineda: This has reference to your Position Paper relative to the passage of City Resolution No. 08-2021 and City Ordinance No. 02-2021 of Malolos, Bulacan, in which this Department is carbon-copied (CC'ed). As represented in your Position Paper, seven (7) Sangguniang Panlungsod (SP) members of Malolos, Bulacan conducted a session without your presence and the other members of the sanggunian. In the said session, ostensibly the seven SP members hastily appointed a temporary presiding officer. They suspended the rules (Internal Rules and Procedures) and passed a resolution that amended the Internal Rules. Further, they approved the Annual Investment Plan and the SP Malolos, Bulacan 2021 Annual Budget. You dispute the propriety of the said session as it was conducted without determining if there is an inability on your part, as Vice-Mayor and Presiding Officer. You represented that you were in your office preparing for the session when the seven SP members conducted the session. As such, you are of the view that there was no inability on your part to preside during the said session. You further assail the approval and adoption of the above-mentioned sangguniang resolution and ordinance were done in less than ten (IO) minutes, with only seven (7) SP members who acted on the same without you and the minority group. Hence, your subject Position Paper against the passage of the subject local legislations. At the outset, please be apprised that the Department is an agency under the executive branch of the govemment and as such, it has no authority to declare null and void any ordinance or resolution of the local sanggunian, or any acts

committed by the members thereof which is alleged to be a violation of the Local Government Code of 1991 (Code) or other applicable laws. Furthermore, the Department is proscribed by its internal rules as provided in DILG Memorandum Order No. 2010-02 to act on queries of the following kinds, to wit: xxx I. Those containing facts that are justifiable in nature. Justiciable issues are those that require adjudication by the courts of law as to who between the opposing parties have the better right over a given controversy; 2. Those presumptively valid acts; e.g., enacted ordinance, consummated acts that already enjoy the presumption of regularity on the part of the public officer concerned, and similar instances; 3. Those that are litis pendencia or pending litigation, except when the court itself, requests for opinion. In the event that the opinion has been rendered by the Department and its field officers without knowledge or the information that a case involving the issues raised in the query is pending in court, such opinion shall automatically be deemed ineffective , and 4. Those that are cognizable by other agencies of the government." At any rate, for purposes of academic discussion coupled with our objective to guide the concerned on the proper course of action to take under the circumstances, we deem it necessary to indulge in disquisition on the laws applicable on the matter. Relevant to the issue at hand is Section 49 of the Code, thus: "Section 49. Presiding Officer. - (a) The vice-governor shall be the presiding officer of the sangguniang panlalawigan; the city vice-mayor, of the sangguniang panlungsod; the municipal vice-mayor, of the sangguniang bayan; and the punong barangay, of the sangguniang barangay. The presiding officer shall vote only to break a tie. (b) In the event of the inability of the regular presiding officer to preside at a sanggunian session, the members present and constituting a quorum shall elect from among themselves a temporary presiding officer. He shall certify within ten (10) days from the passage of ordinances enacted and resolutions adopted by the sanggunian in the session over which he temporarily presided." It is undisputed that the VM of the sangguniang panlugnsod shall be the presiding officer. It is worthy to mention that although the Code allows sangguniang members present in a sanggunian session to elect from among themselves a temporary presiding officer, the same should be done in the event of the inability of the VM or the regular presiding officer. Needless to say,

if there is no inability on the part of the regular presiding officer, then it is incumbent upon the latter to preside the sanggunian session. Further, in such a case, it is deemed improper for the sanggunian members to elect from among themselves a temporary presiding officer. Be that as it may, we are of the view that since the subject legislations in question have already been approved, the same should be accorded the presumption of validity unless declared otherwise by our courts of justice. Accordingly, any issues or questions thereon relative to its non-compliance with the substantive requirements in the passage thereof should already be threshed out by filing a special civil action for Declaratory Relief before the proper court in accordance with Section 1, Rule 63 of the Revised Rules of Court which provides, thus: "Section I. Who may file Petition- Any person interested under a deed, will, contract or other written instrument, or whose rights are affected by a statute, executive order or regulation, or ordinance may, before breach or violation thereof, bring an action in the appropriate Regional Trial Court to determine any question of contraction or validity arising, and for a declaration of his rights or duties thereunder." This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: INGAN Unders cretary for Local Government LLLS/27 Copy furnished: DIR. JULIE J. DAQUIOAG Regional Director, DILG-Region Ill Diosdado Macapagal Government Center Maimpis, City of San Fernando, Pampanga
